lines.beaver: 안녕하세요. 시청 안내예요. 뭘 도와 드릴까요?
lines.beaver_en: Hello. This is the city hall information desk. How can I help you?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo. sicheong annaeyeyo. mwol dowa deurilkkayo?
lines.en: What time does city hall open?

lines.beaver_en: It opens at nine in the morning.
lines.en: Then until what time is it open?

lines.beaver_en: Until six. What brings you here?
lines.learner: 세금을 내러 왔어요. 지금 낼 수 있어요?
lines.en: I came to pay taxes. Can I pay now?
lines.roman: segeumeul naereo wasseoyo. jigeum nael ssu isseoyo?

lines.beaver_en: You can't do that here. Please go to the district office.
lines.en: Until what time is the district office open?

lines.beaver: 구청도 여섯 시까지예요. 지금은 네 시 반이에요.
lines.beaver_en: The district office is also open until six. It's four thirty now.
lines.beaver_roman: gucheongdo yeoseot sikkajieyo. jigeumeun ne si banieyo.
lines.en: Then where is the district office?

lines.beaver: 걸어서 십 분이에요. 잠시만요, 지도 드릴게요.
lines.beaver_en: It's a ten-minute walk. One moment, I'll give you a map.
lines.beaver_roman: georeoseo sip ppunieyo. jamsimanyo, jido deurilkkeyo.
lines.en: Thank you. Are there a lot of people at city hall today?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, there was an event this morning.
lines.en: Then did the mayor come too?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, the mayor came at ten.
lines.en: Does city hall open at nine tomorrow too?

lines.beaver_en: Yes, it opens at nine tomorrow too.
lines.en: I see. Is city hall open on Saturdays too?

lines.beaver_en: No, it's closed on Saturdays and Sundays.
lines.learner: 네, 감사합니다. 지금 구청에 바로 갈게요.
lines.en: Okay, thank you. I'll go to the district office right now.
lines.roman: ne, gamsahamnida. jigeum gucheonge baro galkkeyo.
